description: This file contains the class `UsersViewEdit`, which manages the 'Edit User' view interface in the SuiteCRM system, including pre-display setup, metadata retrieval, button actions, and rendering email-related components.

classes.name: UsersViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit that handles the display and logic for editing user records, including handling different user types, permissions, form buttons, and email UI integration.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares additional fields and setup before rendering the display.

methods.name: getMetaDataFile
methods.description: Determines the metadata file based on user type, with special handling for group users.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to render the user edit view, including setting template variables, handling duplicate users, user status, permissions, email redirection, and button actions.

methods.name: getHelpText
methods.description: Provides help text and create link HTML for the Users module if the current user has admin privileges.
